Overrides the base layer's legacy `useCart`. */ export function useCart() { const lines = useCookie('cart', { default: () => [] }) const count = computed(() => sumBy(lines.value, line => line.qty)) function add(slug: string, qty = 1) { const existing = lines.value.find(line => line.slug === slug) lines.value = existing ? lines.value.map(line => (line.slug === slug ? { ...line, qty: line.qty + qty } : line)) : [...lines.value, { slug, qty }] } function remove(slug: string) { lines.value = lines.value.filter(line => line.slug !== slug) } return { lines, count, add, remove } } === app/composables/useCartTotal.ts import type { Product } from '#shared/types/product' import { computed } from 'vue' import { useNuxtData } from '#imports' import { sumBy } from '#shared/utils/math' import { useCart } from '~/composables/useCart' import { useDiscount } from '~/composables/useDiscount' import { applyDiscount } from '~/utils/discount' /** Cart totals in cents, as shown to the customer. */ export function useCartTotal() { const { lines } = useCart() const { percent } = useDiscount() const { data: products } = useNuxtData('products') const subtotal = computed(() => sumBy(lines.value, (line) => { const product = products.value?.find(p => p.slug === line.slug) return (product?.priceCents ?? 0) * line.qty })) const total = computed(() => applyDiscount(subtotal.value, percent.value)) return { subtotal, total, percent } } === app/composables/useDiscount.ts import { computed } from 'vue' import { useCookie } from '#imports' import { discountPercent } from '#shared/utils/discount' /** The active discount code, read from the `discount-code` cookie. */ export function useDiscount() { const code = useCookie('discount-code', { default: () => null }) const percent = computed(() => discountPercent(code.value)) return { code, percent } } === app/composables/useProducts.ts import type { Product } from '#shared/types/product' import { useFetch } from '#imports' /** All products. Cached under the `products` key, so `useNuxtData('products')` reads them too. */ export function useProducts() { return useFetch('/api/products', { key: 'products', default: () => [] }) } === app/composables/useTheme.ts import { useState } from '#imports' /** The shop is dark. Overrides the base layer's `useTheme`. */ export function useTheme() { return useState('theme', () => 'dark') } === app/utils/discount.ts import { formatMoney } from '~/utils/money' /** * Price after discount, as shown in the UI. * The discount is rounded down, so the UI never promises more than the server quote. */ export function applyDiscount(cents: number, percent: number): number { return cents - Math.floor(cents * percent / 100) } /** `399` -> `-$3.99`. */ export function formatDiscount(cents: number): string { return `-${formatMoney(cents)}` } === app/utils/money.ts /** Money format for the UI: `1999` -> `$19.99`. */ export function formatMoney(cents: number): string { return `$${(cents / 100).toFixed(2)}` } === app/middleware/cart-not-empty.ts import { defineNuxtRouteMiddleware, navigateTo } from '#imports' import { useCart } from '~/composables/useCart' export default defineNuxtRouteMiddleware(() => { const { count } = useCart() if (!count.value) return navigateTo('/cart') }) === app/components/cart/Badge.vue === app/components/cart/Item.vue === app/components/cart/Summary.vue === app/pages/cart.vue === app/pages/checkout.vue === app/pages/index.vue === app/pages/products/[slug].vue === app/layouts/default.vue === app/components/AppFooter.vue === app/components/AppHeader.vue === app/components/product/Card.vue === app/components/product/Grid.vue === app/components/product/Price.vue === tsconfig.json { "files": [], "references": [ { "path": "./.nuxt/tsconfig.app.json" }, { "path": "./.nuxt/tsconfig.server.json" }, { "path": "./.nuxt/tsconfig.shared.json" }, { "path": "./.nuxt/tsconfig.node.json" } ] }
